body.name: CSEobs
body.def: For \(K=2\), \(\operatorname{CSE}^{\mathrm{obs}}_t(b)=\{h_{t,1,1}^{\mathrm{obs}}(b)/h_{t,0,1}^{\mathrm{obs}}(b)\}/\{h_{t,1,2}^{\mathrm{obs}}(b)/h_{t,0,2}^{\mathrm{obs}}(b)\}\) whenever its component denominators are positive.
body.role: observed hazard-ratio functional identifying the marginal challenge subtype effect under the Perényi--Stensrud conditions
